name: Amanda Nunes
summary: The former two-division UFC champion (23-5, age 38) returns from retirement for her first fight since June 2023, when she beat Irene Aldana and laid her gloves down. She is a former American Top Team teammate of Kayla Harrison. Powerful striker, strong top game, proven over five rounds. She is an underdog for the first time since she knocked out Cris Cyborg in 2018.

how_they_fight.Striking: Heavy hands and kicks. Thirteen KO/TKO wins, including 51 seconds against Cyborg and 48 against Rousey. Against Aldana she used her jab and kicks, staggered her with an overhand right and a knee in R3, and landed a big elbow in R4 (Cageside).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Strong wrestler and top player. At least six takedowns against Aldana, including a rear body lock in R3 and an early R5 takedown into ground strikes and a mount (Cageside). In the Peña rematch she landed 6 of 8 takedowns with almost 12 minutes of control (our data). Four submission wins.
how_they_fight.Defense: Can be hurt: Aldana caught her with a counter right at the end of R1 (Cageside). Peña out-landed her 79 to 46 and submitted her in R2 in 2021. Other losses: a 2014 R3 TKO to Cat Zingano, a 2011 R2 TKO to Alexis Davis, a 2013 decision and a 2008 submission in her debut.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Seventeen stoppages: fourteen in R1, two in R2, one in R5 (Pennington). Six five-round decision or late wins and no losses in fights that went past three rounds. Against Aldana she was still landing takedowns and ground strikes in R5.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Mixes striking and wrestling well; against Aldana all three judges gave her every round. Comes in after more than three years out. Says she plans to defend the belt if she wins (MMA Junkie).

patterns: Fast starter with knockout power: 14 of 17 stoppages in R1
Wrestles to top position and grinds in title fights
Gets stronger late in five-round fights
concerns: More than three years out of competition; age 38
Has to stop Harrison's body lock and grappling
Has been hurt and lost to pressure (Peña 2021)
keys_to_beat: Clinch and take her down early, before the power lands
Test her cardio after the layoff

news.text: Says she will defend the belt if she wins: 'And then we're going to see'.
Opens as a +161 underdog at BetOnline, her first time as an underdog since UFC 232 in 2018.
Joselyne Edwards is the backup for the title fight.
